name: Maturity
overview: Scripture reveals that Christian maturity involves progressing beyond basic teachings and becoming firmly grounded in the faith, growing into the full stature of Christ (Ephesians 4:13-14; Hebrews 5:12). This growth is marked by enduring trials that develop patience (Romans 5:3) and moving past elementary doctrines toward spiritual perfection (Hebrews 6:1). Maturity protects believers from being easily swayed by false teachings and enables them to teach others, reflecting a deepened knowledge of Christ and unity in faith.
